annotations.title: Currencies of the world's reserves (IMF COFER)

description: What the world's central banks hold their foreign exchange reserves in, from the IMF's COFER: each currency's share of the reserves whose currency is reported (the dollar, euro, yen, sterling, renminbi and others) and its value in dollars at the latest quarter, the change in share on a year and over ten years, and the shares quarter by quarter. A plain summary first. No key.

quarters.description: Quarters of shares shown, latest last; default 8.

name: reserve_currencies

outputSchema.description: rows are currencies (largest share first, other currencies last) in the order of columns; history is the shares quarter by quarter.
